wow.name: Azeroth
wow.tagline: Orbit camera, tab target, cast bars, threat.
wow.blurb: The camera hangs behind your shoulder and you turn it with the mouse. You pick a target and it stays picked; abilities share a global cooldown and two of them have cast bars you have to stand still for. The tank holds a threat table, the healer lives in the party frames, and the whole fight is a question of when you can afford to stop moving.
wow.signature: Frontal cleave — Magma Cleave comes out of the boss's face in a 130° cone, so the tank's job is to keep it pointed away from everyone else.

magmaCleave.name: Magma Cleave
magmaCleave.desc: A frontal. Everything in the cone in front of it gets hit.

extras: Threat meter — everyone's threat against the tank's, live. Cross it and it comes for you.
Fight timeline — every telegraph is on a schedule, and the schedule is on screen.

quake.name: Slipgate
quake.tagline: First person. Fast. Aim is everything.
quake.blurb: Eyes in the front of your head, and nothing between you and the arena. No target lock, no cast bars, no global cooldown — only fire rates and ammo. The healer aims heals like a weapon and the tank holds aggro by out-damaging you, so the trinity survives, but every job is now a shooting job.
quake.signature: Pickups — Quad Damage and Megahealth spawn on the floor on a timer. You have to go and stand on them, which is the whole reason Quake maps are shaped the way they are.
extras: Momentum — hold a direction and you keep winding up to +13% speed. Stop and you lose all of it.
Item timers — the pickups respawn on a clock you can read, so the arena is a rotation.

overwatch.name: Overload
overwatch.tagline: Third person, held primary, big cooldowns.
overwatch.blurb: Over the shoulder. Your primary is something you hold rather than something you tap, and the rest of the kit is two or three heavy cooldowns you spend at the right moment. Healing is a beam you keep pointed at someone while the fight moves around both of you.
overwatch.signature: Barrier — the Vanguard's ultimate stops being a damage reduction and becomes a deployed shield: a pool of absorb across the whole party that gets chewed through.

pentagram.name: Barrier
pentagram.desc: ULTIMATE. Drops a barrier over the party: 150,000 of absorb each, until it is chewed through.

extras: Ultimate combo — two ultimates live in the same window and the whole party gets Overloaded.
Team charge — everyone's ultimate meter is on screen, so you can hold yours for theirs.
Overheat — the held primary builds heat and locks out when it redlines. Holding the trigger is not a strategy.

souls.name: The Pit
souls.tagline: Lock on, roll, block, watch stamina.
souls.blurb: The camera locks onto the thing trying to kill you and you circle it. Rolling costs stamina and gives you half a second of invulnerability; blocking costs stamina and breaks if you run dry. Slow, deliberate, and unforgiving — the tank's job becomes reading the wind-up rather than reading a threat meter.
souls.signature: Parry — raise your guard in the half second before a blow lands and you turn it aside completely, staggering the boss and leaving it taking 35% more for 2.5s.
extras: Poise — the boss has a guard bar. Hit it, hit it from behind, parry it, and it breaks open.
Swings cost stamina — attacking, rolling and blocking all draw on the same bar.
